content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Honolulu

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP® credential. Review the specific hour thresholds and degree options on PMI's official eligibility guidelines, then document your qualifying background before proceeding.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® Boot Camp. Our Honolulu-based cohorts deliver the PMI-required formal education in an interactive, real-time format—no pre-recorded videos—so you learn alongside peers and ask instructors directly.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your PMP® application with PMI, including proof of your boot-camp completion and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee to secure your testing eligibility and official candidate status with PMI.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Test
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor office hours—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam when ready, then sit for the PMP® computer-based test at an authorized Pearson Vue center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout your three-year renewal cycle by attending training, volunteering, or contributing to the profession. Submit your earned PDUs to PMI before your credential expiration to maintain active PMP® status.
